test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The lockdown during Covid-19 in certain places has imposed threatening __constraints__ on market economy and it will take time to recover from this.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"constraints"** means limitations or restrictions that limit the freedom to act. (सीमाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** The constraints of the budget forced the team to cut down on expenses.
 
 
 
• **"Restrictions"** refers to rules or conditions that limit or control what can be done. (प्रतिबंध)
 
 
• **Example:** The city has imposed restrictions on water usage due to the drought.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Problems** (समस्याएँ): Difficulties or challenges that need to be resolved.
 
 
• **Example:** The team faced many problems during the project implementation.
 
 
 
• **Beliefs** (धारणाएं): Convictions or acceptances that certain things are true or real.
 
 
• **Example:** His beliefs about health and wellness guide his daily routine.
 
 
 
• **Faiths** (विश्वास ): Strong trust or confidence in something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She has strong faith in her abilities to succeed.
